svg.title: LexiFAR architecture
svg.desc: Four supervised stages share a six-block backbone. The first and second stages use one LSTM each, the third uses two Transformers, and the fourth uses two Mamba blocks. Source-only word predictions at the first three stages produce position weights and probability-weighted replacement vectors for the next stage. Stage three also has an auxiliary sentence loss. All four projected features are concatenated per token, projected from 4d to d and decoded by the tied vocabulary head. Only P4 generates the final rewrite. The right panel expands the shared contextual word edit module.

g.aria-label: Mamba mixer with a selective state-space path and a SiLU gate

Four independent projected features enter the concatenation
Source-only word guide E1 feeds the next backbone stage
Source-only word guide E2 feeds the next backbone stage
Source-only word guide E3 feeds the next backbone stage
Concatenation, learned four-to-one projection, tied vocabulary head and sole final rewrite
Concatenate F1 through F4 per token
One joint training objective for all stages
g.text: L = 0.25 mean(CEw,1, CEw,2, CEw,3) + 0.50 CEaux + 0.50 CEfinal
Shared at P₁, P₂ and P₃
H′ᵢ = Hᵢ + gᵢ · W LN(Hᵢ) + rᵢ
